# ===============================
#   MAIN FUNCTION

make_species_plots <- function(yvar, y_label = yvar, y_limits = c(0, 150)) {
  
  # dynamic column reference
  ycol <- rlang::sym(yvar)
  
  make_one_plot <- function(species_name) {
    
    df <- data[data$name == species_name, ]
  
    # mean of control
    mean_control <- mean(df[df$Sub == "C", ][[yvar]], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    ggplot(df, aes(x = Sub, y = !!ycol, colour = Sub)) +
      
      geom_boxplot(aes(group = Sub),
                   colour = "black",
                   fill = "grey90",
                   alpha = 0.5) +
      
      geom_hline(yintercept = mean_control,
                 colour = "black",
                 linetype = "dotted",
                 linewidth = 1) +
      
      geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6) +
      
      annotate("label",
               x = 4, y = y_limits[2] - 1,
               label = elevation_map[[species_name]],
               fill = "white",
               colour = "black",
               size = 3) +
      
      scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits) +
      
      labs(title = bquote(italic(.(species_name))),
           x = "",
           y = y_label) +
      
      theme_bw() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
      }
  
  # Build 6 plots
  p_list <- lapply(species_order, make_one_plot)
  
  final_plot <- ((p_list[[1]] | p_list[[2]] | p_list[[3]]) /
                   (p_list[[4]] | p_list[[5]] | p_list[[6]])) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
#ggsave(filename= paste0("species_boxplots_", y_label,".png"),
#       plot = final_plot,
#       width = 10, height = 10, units = "in", dpi = 300)

  return(final_plot)
}

  "Myrcia sp nov",

plot_6_species_histograms <- function(data, species_vector, var_name = "iWUE") {
  
  # set grid: 2 rows × 3 columns
  par(mfrow = c(2, 3))
  
  for (sp in species_vector) {
    df <- subset(data, name == sp)
    
    # check if variable exists
    
    x <- df[[var_name]]
    
    # if no data
    if (length(x) == 0 || !is.numeric(x)) {
      plot.new()
      title(main = paste("No data for:", sp))
      next
    }
    
    hist(x,
         main = paste("Histogram:", sp),
         xlab = var_name)
  }
}
plot_6_species_histograms(data, species_vector, var_name = "iWUE (μmol/mol)") #add the different variables here.

library(ggplot2)
library(broom.mixed)
library(dplyr)

coefs <- tidy(
  mod_N_cr,
  effects = "fixed",
  conf.int = TRUE,
  conf.level = 0.95
) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)")

coefs <- coefs %>%
  mutate(
    sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE            ~ ""
    )
  )

ggplot(coefs, aes(x = term, y = estimate)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
    width = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sig, y = conf.high),
    vjust = -0.6,
    size = 5)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  labs(
    x = "Sub",
    y = "Estimate (± 95% CI)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

coefs$term <- gsub("^Sub", "", coefs$term)

plot_diagnostics <- function(model, model_name) {
  
  res <- residuals(model)#residual
  fit <- fitted(model) #model
  
  par(mfrow = c(1, 2)) #graph
  
  # Residuals vs Fitted
  plot(fit, res,
       xlab = "Fitted values",
       ylab = "Residuals",
       main = paste(model_name, "\nResiduals vs Fitted"))
  abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)
  
  # QQ plot
  qqnorm(res, main = paste(model_name, "\nNormal Q-Q"))
  qqline(res, col = "red", lty = 2)
  
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
}

#apply the plot_diagnostics_to_all
pdf("model_diagnostics_species.pdf", width = 10, height = 5)

for (nm in names(models)) {
  plot_diagnostics(models[[nm]], nm)
}

dev.off()

testUniformity(res)

## 
##  Exact one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test
## 
## data:  simulationOutput$scaledResiduals
## D = 0.17133, p-value = 0.6065
## alternative hypothesis: two-sided
testDispersion(res)

## 
##  DHARMa nonparametric dispersion test via sd of residuals fitted vs.
##  simulated
## 
## data:  simulationOutput
## dispersion = 0.81997, p-value = 0.642
## alternative hypothesis: two.sided
testOutliers(res)

## 
##  DHARMa outlier test based on exact binomial test with approximate
##  expectations
## 
## data:  res
## outliers at both margin(s) = 0, observations = 18, p-value = 1
## alternative hypothesis: true probability of success is not equal to 0.001998002
## 95 percent confidence interval:
##  0.000000 0.185302
## sample estimates:
## frequency of outliers (expected: 0.001998001998002 ) 
##                                                    0
pdf("DHARMa_diagnostics_species.pdf", width = 9, height = 7)

for (nm in names(models)) {
  res <- simulateResiduals(models[[nm]], n = 1000)
  plot(res, main = nm)
}
